serviceDetails.title: Can I run my heating from my phone?
paras: Yes. With Hive you can warm your home before you get in, switch the heating off from bed, or turn it down when you are away, all from the app. You can set a schedule for each day, and change it any time from anywhere.
serviceDetails.alt: Hive app controlling heating from a phone

serviceDetails.title: Can Hive save me money?
paras: It can, if used well. Better control means less heat wasted in empty rooms and empty hours. You can turn the heating down when plans change, and see when your heating runs, which helps you spot waste.
serviceDetails.alt: Hive thermostat fitted in a Watford home

serviceDetails.title: Can Hive control each room?
paras: Yes, with Hive smart radiator valves. Each valve lets you set the temperature of one room from the app, so you only heat the rooms you use. We can fit the valves when we fit your Hive thermostat, or add them later.
serviceDetails.alt: Hive smart radiator valves for room by room control

serviceDetails.title: Do you set Hive up for me?
paras: Yes. We fit Hive, link the app to your phone, test the connection to your boiler and set your schedule. Then we show you how to use it, from changing the temperature to setting holiday mode. You are ready to go the moment we leave.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer setting up the Hive app on a phone

serviceDetails.title: Can you replace my old thermostat with Hive?
paras: Yes. We remove your old thermostat and timer, fit Hive in their place and make good the wall. If your old thermostat is in a bad spot, such as a draughty hallway, we can place Hive somewhere better for an accurate reading.

serviceDetails.title: Does Hive work with my boiler?
paras: Hive works with most gas boilers and heating systems. We check your boiler and wiring first and confirm it will work before we fit. If you are getting a new boiler, we can fit Hive at the same time.
serviceDetails.alt: Checking a boiler works with Hive

serviceDetails.title: Hive or Nest: which is best for me?
paras: Both are good choices. Hive is simple to use, with an easy app and optional smart radiator valves. Nest learns your routine and adjusts the heating for you. We fit both, and talk you through which suits your home and how you live. See our thermostat installation page for other options.
serviceDetails.alt: Hive compared with other smart thermostats

serviceDetails.title: Why choose AR Heating?
paras: We are a local Watford company, trading since 2007, and every gas job is done under our Gas Safe registration, No. 574111. We give you a fixed price before we start, turn up when we say we will, and leave your home as clean as we found it. If something is not worth doing, we tell you.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe registered AR Heating engineer

serviceDetails.title: Can you fit Hive with a new boiler?
paras: Yes, and it is a good time to do it. When we fit your new boiler, we can fit Hive at the same time, wire both together and set them up in one visit. You get a new boiler and smart controls working together from day one.
serviceDetails.alt: Hive fitted with a new boiler

serviceDetails.title: What can I do with Hive day to day?
paras: Set a different schedule for weekdays and weekends. Boost the heating for an hour when it turns cold. Turn the heating down when you go away, and back up before you get home. Check the temperature at home from anywhere. Small changes like these add up over a winter.
serviceDetails.alt: Turning heating down while away with Hive

faqs.q: Can I run my heating from my phone with Hive?
faqs.a: Yes. The Hive app lets you control your heating and set schedules from anywhere.
It can, if used well, because better control cuts wasted heat.

faqs.q: Can Hive control hot water too?
faqs.a: Some Hive models can control hot water on systems with a cylinder. We check your system and advise.

faqs.q: Do I need wifi for Hive?
faqs.a: Yes. Hive uses your home wifi to connect to the app.

faqs.q: Does Hive work with my boiler?
faqs.a: Hive works with most systems. We check your boiler first to confirm.

faqs.q: Can you replace my old thermostat with Hive?
faqs.a: Yes. We remove the old control, fit Hive and set up the whole system.

faqs.q: Can you fit Hive with a new boiler?
faqs.a: Yes. We can fit it at the same time as your new boiler, so both are set up together.

faqs.q: How long does the fit take?
faqs.a: Most fits take a few hours at most, including app set up and showing you how it works.

faqs.q: What happens if my wifi goes down?
faqs.a: Hive keeps running your heating on its schedule. You just cannot change it from the app until the wifi is back.

faqs.q: Can more than one person control Hive?
faqs.a: Yes. You can share access with others in your home, so everyone can use the app.
